test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c715b4c41237a92000b3c3a14c37928f65f784a3bac9e52c1dc066cce7ad27d8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

* symbol is shifting in anticlockwise direction at the surface in each figure.

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Diagonal symbols are changing their position.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

All 4 corner symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9c1230ccbd1460040b90200a7580d09dc45658e255916c2a23becff90fbf9e4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
